name: a contested claim cannot be resolved twice
notes: Shape is load-bearing beyond the outcome. The harness derives each prior event's id from its POSITION (fx_evt_<seq>), so the contest recorded first is fx_evt_1, and both the prior resolution and the candidate must name it. Complete-then-filter in buildInMemoryContext is what keeps that true. Filter first and the contests are REMOVED before they are ever given ids, so getContest can never find one; in the sibling shape, where a two-list implementation keeps the contests but numbers them off a filtered enumeration, the surviving ids are RENUMBERED instead. Removed or renumbered, this fixture stops finding fx_evt_1 either way and refuses contest.unknown — still refused, wrong rule.

payload.reason: Only the assignee may do this.

expected.reason: This contested claim is already resolved; a second resolution would rewrite history.
